+import os
+from typing import List, Sequence
+
+from openai import OpenAI
+
+
+def batch_translate(texts: Sequence[str], source_language: str, target_language: str, model: str = "gpt-4.1-mini") -> List[str]:
+    client = OpenAI(api_key=os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY"))
+    response = client.responses.create(
+        model=model,
+        input=[
+            {
+                "role": "system",
+                "content": (
+                    f"Translate each input string from {source_language} to {target_language}. "
+                    "Return a JSON array of translated strings in the same order, preserving order exactly."
+                ),
+            },
+            {
+                "role": "user",
+                "content": "\n".join(f"{i}: {text}" for i, text in enumerate(texts)),
+            },
+        ],
+        text={"format": {"type": "json_object"}},
+    )
+    output_text = response.output_text
+    data = __import__("json").loads(output_text)
+    if not isinstance(data, list):
+        raise ValueError("Expected a JSON array of translations")
+    if len(data) != len(texts):
+        raise ValueError("Translation count did not match input count")
+    return [str(item) for item in data]

+import os
+from typing import Any, Dict, Optional
+
+import requests
+
+
+OPENAI_API_URL = "https://api.openai.com/v1/responses"
+OPENAI_MODEL = "gpt-5.4-mini"
+
+
+def translate_text(text: str, source_language: str, target_language: str, api_key: Optional[str] = None) -> str:
+    if not text:
+        return text
+    key = api_key or os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY")
+    if not key:
+        raise ValueError("OPENAI_API_KEY is required")
+    prompt = (
+        f"Translate the following text from {source_language} to {target_language}. "
+        f"Return only the translated text, preserving meaning and style:\n{text}"
+    )
+    payload: Dict[str, Any] = {
+        "model": OPENAI_MODEL,
+        "input": prompt,
+    }
+    response = requests.post(
+        OPENAI_API_URL,
+        headers={
+            "Authorization": f"Bearer {key}",
+            "Content-Type": "application/json",
+        },
+        json=payload,
+        timeout=60,
+    )
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    data = response.json()
+    return _extract_output_text(data)
+
+
+def _extract_output_text(data: Dict[str, Any]) -> str:
+    if isinstance(data, dict):
+        if "output_text" in data and isinstance(data["output_text"], str):
+            return data["output_text"].strip()
+        output = data.get("output")
+        if isinstance(output, list):
+            parts = []
+            for item in output:
+                if not isinstance(item, dict):
+                    continue
+                content = item.get("content")
+                if isinstance(content, list):
+                    for part in content:
+                        if isinstance(part, dict):
+                            text = part.get("text")
+                            if isinstance(text, str):
+                                parts.append(text)
+            if parts:
+                return "".join(parts).strip()
+    raise ValueError("Unexpected response format from OpenAI API")
+
*** End Patch
